name: halden/story
title: Story (sticky media + steps)
description: "What your rack runs on": sticky image with caption, scrolling steps with a big number, chips and a live line graphic, then the carriers band. Steps and carriers are lists edited in the code editor.

intro.default: You bring the servers. The building brings everything around them, sized for dense compute and independently audited.

default.title: Redundant power, ready for GPUs
default.text: Every rack runs on N+1 UPS with diesel generator failover. HAL2 delivers three-phase power for high-density compute.
default.alt: Close-up of a circuit board with glowing amber components.

default.title: Cooled by deep lake water
default.text: The building is cooled through deep lake water, drawn from Alder Lake through the town's lake-water loop.
default.alt: A cold aisle between glass-fronted cabinets, lit blue.

default.title: Locked, logged and audited
default.text: Biometric access, staff on site around the clock, unescorted access for your team, and a SOC 2 Type II report your auditors can read.
default.alt: Server racks beside a mounted screen showing a login panel.

default.title: Carriers one cross connect away
default.text: Your rack sits in the building where Canadian carriers meet. Cross connects are provisioned from our end in 1 to 2 business days, with no cap.
default.alt: Patch panels with neatly bundled grey network cables.

carriersTitle.default: On-net at 200 Foundry Row, ready to cross connect.

carriersText.default: A sample of the carriers, exchange and cloud on-ramps you can reach from your rack without leaving the building.
